verdict.rationale: Hightouch's hybrid architecture stores no customer data in Hightouch itself—data stays in the customer's own warehouse/S3 bucket—which gives users effective control over where their data resides by choosing their own warehouse's region, and this underpins its use by regulated fintech/healthcare customers. However, there is no explicit documentation of a region-selection setting or residency options within Hightouch's own platform/control plane. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration UI or docs, statements about where Hightouch's own metadata/control plane is hosted, and any multi-region deployment options.
